text: Adele Fiona Boone, an Electrical Engineer, had an unusual week. The UEBA system flagged the week due to two triggered detection rules. First, there were 4 logons outside her typical working hours, which is a significant increase from her usual 0.5 logons. Second, she visited job-search sites 70 times, which is more than double her typical 36 visits and significantly higher than the average among peers in the same role.
